selectorProvenance: ‘read’ = the selector was read in src/journal/shell.pcss (fetched) or in the synced journal.pcss build (_ds_bundle.css of matron-web@1.12.11-rc.0). components.tsx was grepped, not read end-to-end. Anything not read is status:new with a `suggested` name and is never asserted to exist (§10.9).

fields.status: implemented = the selector exists in the repo today · new = does not exist; `suggested` is a proposal
fields.visual: aligned = the design uses the live values unchanged · divergent = the design changes the live values (see `diff`) · unverified = cannot be determined from source; leave to the auto-diff
fields.compare: computed props the auto-diff should compare; tolerance applies to px values, colours compare exactly after theme resolution
